summary: Frontend-only regression for the new SCACCO MATTO ring page. Executed ~55 assertions across desktop (1280x900) and mobile (375x800) covering page metadata, karat/colour pill logic, white-gold lock, ring-size + add-to-cart validation, cart drawer + localStorage payload, gallery order/reset, shop card, inspiration-vault non-inclusion, and regression on STAMPEDE SET / RIBBON REGALE. Result: 53/55 pass. Two failures — one real bug (cart localStorage is missing karat/metalColour/ringSize fields required by spec) and one likely spec-compliance edge case (validation banner not appearing when the disabled attribute is stripped and .click() is fired synchronously via JS on sm-add-to-cart).

ui_bugs.issue: The mapping in /app/frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.jsx (lines 35-55) does NOT forward the karat / metalColour / ringSize fields that ScaccoMattoPage passes into handleAddToCart. Cart localStorage after adding 14K/Yellow/US10 contains {product_id, name, image, unit_amount_cents:1200000, lockedPriceCad:12000, sku:'SM-14K-YELLOW-10', variant:'14K · Yellow Gold · US 10', currency:'CAD', materials:[...]} but is MISSING karat:'14K', metalColour:'Yellow Gold', ringSize:'US 10'. Review spec explicitly requires these three keys in the cart payload.

When sm-add-to-cart is disabled (no size chosen) and the disabled attribute is stripped and .click() fired via JS, the sm-validation banner did not render within 200ms. onAddToCart source clearly calls setShowValidation(true) when !isValid, so this may be a React re-render race caused by disabled being reasserted before the handler fires. Please verify with a real user flow: skip the disabled bypass and confirm that a legitimate flow without size shows the banner. If handler is bypassed by React, consider removing the disabled attr entirely and enforcing validation only inside onClick.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.jsx addToCart (around lines 35-55), forward karat, metalColour, ringSize (and any other selection-descriptor fields) from the incoming product object onto newItem so they persist to localStorage['phileon_cart']. Spec requires: karat, metalColour, ringSize on the top-level cart item.

Verify sm-validation renders when the CTA is programmatically clicked with size empty (test bypass scenario). Consider always rendering the handler check regardless of disabled attribute — if E1 already does, this may just be a Playwright DOM-race and can be re-verified with a manual click after removing the disabled attribute via devtools.
critical_code_review_comments: ScaccoMattoPage.jsx (652 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold. The 330-line inline <style> block is the main contributor. Consider moving the CSS to /app/frontend/src/pages/scacco-matto/scacco-matto.css and importing it — the JSX will drop to ~300 lines and stay maintainable.

CartContext.addToCart uses positional field allowlist; any new descriptor field passed by product pages is silently dropped (root cause of the karat/metalColour/ringSize regression). Consider spreading `...product` at the end or maintaining an explicit `descriptorFields` array so future ring/necklace variants don't require CartContext edits.

chooseColour early-returns for disabled but the button still has role='radio' aria-checked=false which is correct; however, disabled radios in a radiogroup can confuse screen readers when tabIndex=-1. Consider aria-hidden='false' + aria-label including 'coming soon' for a11y clarity (nice-to-have).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-verify only the two failures after E1 fix: (1) inspect localStorage['phileon_cart'] after adding SCACCO MATTO 14K/Yellow/US10 and assert karat, metalColour, ringSize keys are present with values '14K','Yellow Gold','US 10'. (2) With size empty, remove disabled attribute from [data-testid='sm-add-to-cart'] via el.removeAttribute('disabled'), click it, and assert [data-testid='sm-validation'] becomes visible. All other 53 assertions were passing; a spot-check of the same happy-path flow should be sufficient.
rca of the issue: CartContext.addToCart (lines 36-55) constructs newItem by hand-picking product fields. ScaccoMattoPage correctly passes karat, metalColour, ringSize into handleAddToCart -> addToCart, but those keys are never copied into newItem, so localStorage['phileon_cart'] lacks them. Mitigation: add `karat: product.karat || null, metalColour: product.metalColour || null, ringSize: product.ringSize || null` (or spread the product before overriding) inside the newItem literal.
